ModifyMaxEnergy.rationale: BlessedAntler.cs:24-31 adds EnergyVar(1).IntValue to the owner's max energy; the sim adds ENERGY = 1. The sim's modify_max_energy is consulted at player.py:163, which is audit/records/seam/turn_structure.json step 17's Hook.ModifyMaxEnergy -- the same point in the turn, before the reset/add decision.

BeforeHandDraw.rationale: THE MAPPING IS CORRECT HERE, and the executed order is why. py audit/tools/relic_probes.py turn-order shows the sim fires on_energy_reset -> on_player_turn_start -> modify_hand_draw; audit/records/seam/turn_structure.json puts AfterEnergyReset at step 18, BeforeHandDraw at 19 and ModifyHandDraw at 20. So the sim's on_player_turn_start IS the BeforeHandDraw slot -- which is what relics/base.py:11's mapping table gets wrong when it labels the same method 'BeforeSideTurnStart' (that is step 9, five steps earlier; see PROMPT.md bug class 11). This relic needs the pre-draw position: three Dazed must be in the draw pile BEFORE the turn-1 hand is drawn, or they cannot be drawn into the opening hand. `TurnNumber == 1` matches `self.turn != 1: return`, and 3 matches CardsVar(3).

guards.what: N1: C# adds all 3 Dazed in ONE AddGeneratedCardsToCombat call (BlessedAntler.cs:43); the sim makes three separate add_to_draw calls
guards.rationale: Checked rather than assumed, because a batch insert that computed all three random slots against the ORIGINAL pile size would consume the Shuffle stream differently and land the cards elsewhere. It does not: AddGeneratedCardsToCombat's body (CardPileCmd.cs) is a `foreach (CardModel card in list)` that awaits `Add(card, pile, position)` once per card, so each Random slot is drawn against the pile as it grows -- structurally identical to the sim's three sequential calls. NOTE per binding rule 7: this rationale leans on CardPileCmd.cs, which this record does NOT hash; a change to that loop invalidates this verdict without making the record stale.

The `player != base.Owner` / `shuffler == base.Owner` / `cardPlay.Card.Owner != base.Owner` family is the multiplayer per-player filter on a hook the game dispatches for every player. The sim is single-player by construction (one RunState, one PlayerCombatState), so the filter is structurally satisfied. Multiplayer-only paths are out of scope under the shared contract.

guards.what: N3: Flash(), Cmd.Wait(3f), the card-pile-add preview and the Energy/Dazed hover tips (BlessedAntler.cs:13-22, 37, 43-44)
guards.rationale: RelicModel.Flash() / base.Status / ShowCounter / DisplayAmount / CanonicalVars / ExtraHoverTips / Cmd.Wait / CardCmd.Preview are presentation only -- the relic bar's glow, counter and hover text, and animation timing. The sim has no relic UI. Waived under the shared contract's presentation/animation exclusion, not under an unreachability claim.
